_readme: High and critical advisories that were already in the shipped (non-dev) dependency tree when the audit gate was added on 2026-10-06 (frontend main 31d77000), plus later ones that cannot reach users.
.github/scripts/dependency-audit.mjs fails on any high or critical advisory NOT listed here.

Each entry is {package, via, reason}. `via` lists the dependency chains the reason covers, ending in the package (e.g. "@huggingface/transformers>sharp"); a reported path must end with one of them. The gate also fails when a listed advisory shows up in another package or through a chain not listed, because the reason no longer covers it.
To retire an entry: bump the dependency, re-run the gate, and delete the entry. The gate prints a notice for every entry that no longer matches anything.
Never add an entry or a chain just to turn the gate green: say why the advisory cannot reach users through that chain, or what is tracking the fix.
